Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Civil engineers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Civil Engineers ($116,480). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $116,480, Austin $100,470, Chicago $100,160. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Civil engineers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Civil Engineers (9,760 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 9,760, Seattle 7,680, Austin 4,940. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Civil engineers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (1.62). Published LQs: Austin 1.62, Seattle 1.56, Chicago 0.91.

What is the hourly median for Civil engineers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $48.30; Chicago $48.16; Seattle $56.00. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
